args: Inspect harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-kern-table.hh, especially OT::KernSubTableFormat3::sanitize and get_kerning. Explain the intended format-3 layout, whether the currently unreachable validation is sufficient and overflow-safe, and what minimal root-cause patch best restores safe sanitization while preserving valid format-3 kern tables.

The supplied ASan reproducer is a tiny SFNT whose legacy OpenType kern table contains a declared 16-byte horizontal format-3 subtable. The format-3 fields claim glyphCount=0xff20 and kernValueCount=0xff but provide no arrays. KernSubTableFormat3::sanitize reportedly returns true unconditionally before existing structural validation. During shaping, get_kerning computes kernValue, leftClass, rightClass, and kernIndex pointers from those attacker-controlled counts and reads leftClass[0] far outside the blob. I have not edited code yet; I want to determine whether simply removing the unconditional return is correct, including whether sanitize checks the subtable's declared boundary rather than merely the enclosing blob and whether arithmetic can overflow.
